caption: The drawing depicts a single black ceramic pitcher positioned centrally on a flat surface that is light greenish-brown in color. The pitcher is slightly reflective, rounded, and has a single handle attached to one side. The top rim of the pitcher appears chipped and uneven, and the bottom edge is rough and worn, revealing some brownish material underneath the black surface. The pitcher casts a faint shadow on the surface beneath. In the upper portion of the drawing, there is large text in uppercase red letters that reads “BLACK PITCHER CIRCA 1800” on a beige background. The overall palette consists of subdued, earthy tones: black, brown, greenish-brown, beige, and red.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
